central_question: Does one-step storage-transition memory carry blind predictive information about next-interval total-storage change beyond static storage summaries under prescribed-head groundwater forcing?

derivation_authority.coefficient_source_rule: Use the exact persisted P8A coefficient artifact produced from G21-G24 before any P8B route is executed. No refitting, rescaling or candidate pruning on P8B data.

scoring_domain: Transitions whose next interval uses prescribed-head bottom mode; first transition requiring unavailable previous memory is excluded.

metrics.primary: pooled one-step storage-change RMSE by material and candidate

hypotheses.H1: STORAGE_MEMORY1 has lower pooled RMSE than STORAGE for both B01 and B14.
hypotheses.H2: STORAGE_MEMORY1 has lower pooled RMSE than STORAGE_LOWER80 for both B01 and B14.
hypotheses.H3: The direction of the STORAGE_MEMORY1 versus STORAGE improvement is reported for every blind history; no history-level exclusion is permitted.
hypotheses.H4: STORAGE_LOWER80_MEMORY1 is diagnostic only; no preregistered directional claim versus STORAGE_MEMORY1.

interpretation_boundary: Support means transition memory carries response-relevant information for this one-step purpose under the tested workload.
Support does not establish a production ROM, universal memory order, or application acceptance.
Failure does not invalidate P6B/P7A conservation-law identities.
